title: Be Haal Karbala Vich Yasrab De Wali
body:
Pursadari 7 shawal inhedam Jannat ul Baqia
Kalam Be Haal Karbala Wich Yasrab Dy Wali Huay
Markazi Matami Anjuman Guldasta Jaffria Lahore
Noha Khawan Salar Zawar Ali Raza ( Noshi )
Poet Saqlain Akbar
Soz Akbar Abbas Katri bawa
Location Darbar Hazrat Shah Shams Tabreez Multan
